## Problem and result

Explain the concrete problem, resulting behavior, and related issue if any.

## Verification

List actual commands/results and any unverified behavior. For validator fixes,
include a minimal case that failed before and passes after the change. For
prompt/diagram changes, show a sanitized before/after and check it against the PRD.

## Compatibility

Note affected templates, metadata, finding codes or runner behavior, or state
that contracts are unchanged. Keep changes focused and exclude private data.
